answer.summary: All 427 API test errors come from one deterministic classpath clash: Spring Boot's MetricsAutoConfiguration calls DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry), which the Micrometer jar on the classpath lacks, so the Spring context never starts. The PR changes pom.xml (Spring Boot parent 4.x upgrade via Renovate), so re-running will fail the same way. Fix the Boot/Micrometer version alignment in pom.xml, not the tests.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
